items.title: Chery begreep beslissing van Sano: 'Dat risico wil je niet nemen'
items.summary: Tjaronn Chery verscheen dinsdag met gemengde gevoelens voor de camera van Ziggo Sport. De 38-jarige aanvoerder leidde NEC naar een gelijkspel tegen Olympiakos , maar er had misschien wel meer in gezeten. De keuze van Kodai Sano begreep hij wel.

items.title: Infantino calls executive meeting as criticism mounts
items.summary: Gianni Infantino summons senior leaders to a meeting on Wednesday, after facing more fierce criticism of his plan to sell off Fifa's commercial and event operations.

items.title: Bologna zet deur open voor (tijdelijk?) vertrek Dallinga
items.summary: Thijs Dallinga kan Bologna de komende maand mogelijk verlaten. De Italiaanse club denkt mee aan een oplossing. Een verhuurperiode behoort tot de mogelijkheden.

items.title: NEC op Rapport: alleen maar voldoendes bij Europese rentree, Nejasmic uitblinker
items.summary: NEC kende dinsdagavond een uitstekende rentree in Europa. In de derde voorronde van de Champions League ontbrak eigenlijk alleen een doelpunt tegen Olympiakos (0-0). De goede prestatie leverde ook positieve rapportcijfers op.

items.title: Ook mogelijke volgende Champions League-tegenstanders van NEC spelen gelijk
items.summary: NEC is na dinsdagavond nog weinig wijzer over de eventuele tegenstander in de laatste voorronde van de Champions League. In Oostende speelden Union Sint-Gillis en Bodø/Glimt met 3-3 gelijk. Olympique Lyon verloor in Praag en moet volgende week uit een ander vaatje tappen.

items.title: Hoe NEC in vechtwedstrijd de ruimte vond bij Tjaronn Chery
items.summary: NEC heeft Olympiakos Piraeus in eigen stadion aan het wankelen gebracht: 0-0. Tactische analyse van een wedstrijd waarin NEC mee kon in de intensiteit van een goede tegenstander.

items.title: Barcelona sign Brazil forward Kerolin from Manchester City for club-record £1.25m
items.summary: Transfer fee largest sum received for a sale by WSL side Signing eclipses Olivia Smith’s £1m move to Arsenal Barcelona have signed the Brazil forward Kerolin from Manchester City for an undisclosed fee that sources say is in the region of £1.25m, which would represent the largest sum received for a sale by a Women’s Super League side. The deal is also a club-record for Barcelona, and in terms of a fee received by an English club it eclipses the £1m that Liverpool received for the sale of Olivia Smith in Arsenal in 2025 and Melvine Malard’s more recent £850,000 switch from Manchester United to Chelsea. items.title: Fifa accused of using ‘blackmail’ to force support for Infantino’s re-election bid
items.summary: Jordan FA president says Fifa threatened to block funds Secretary general calls selloff plan ‘sad and reproachable’ The Jordan Football Association president, Prince Ali bin al-Hussein, has accused Gianni Infantino’s administration of “blackmail”, claiming that Fifa threatened to withhold financial assistance from his federation if it refused to back the president’s bid for re-election. In a major intervention Prince Ali, who ran for the Fifa presidency against Infantino in 2016 and finished third, listed a number of problems dogging the global governing body and said Jordan’s players have not yet been paid for appearing in the Arab Cup last year. Prince Ali is head of the West Asian Football Federation, which includes influential states such as Qatar and the United Arab Emirates that have thus far backed Infantino to stay on. Continue reading...

items.summary: Olid expected to meet players on Wednesday United squad pays tribute to former head coach Skinner Manchester United are set to appoint the former Hearts manager Eva Olid as their new head coach to replace Marc Skinner, following his exit on Monday, multiple sources have told the Guardian. Talks with the 40-year-old are understood to be very advanced and she is expected to be introduced to the United squad on Wednesday. Continue reading...

items.title: Football Daily | Chelsea, Jordan Henderson and a transfer pivot for the ages
items.summary: Sign up now! Sign up now! Sign up now? Sign up now! Who’s next? Can they convince Craig Gordon to reverse his recent retirement? Invite Bolo Zenden back for a second spell at Stamford Bridge? Get Kieran Richardson to replace Marc Cucurella? Chelsea really have cooked up a fascinating transfer policy: to recreate the Sunderland XI that triumphed 3-0 at the Bridge in November 2010. Danny Welbeck, 19 and on loan from Manchester United, sealed victory that day; Jordan Henderson, 20 and days away from his England debut, ran things in the middle alongside Lee Cattermole. Sixteen years later, Welbeck and Henderson are teammates once again, brought together by Chelsea’s sudden realisation that Alan Hansen had a point. items.title: Frank Lampard hails ‘huge’ signing as Coventry seal record £22.5m Rushworth deal
items.summary: The 25-year-old excelled during promotion campaign Brighton goalkeeper completes permanent switch Coventry have completed the club-record £22.5m signing of goalkeeper Carl Rushworth from Brighton as Frank Lampard’s side continue to prepare for their return to the Premier League after 25 years away. The 25-year-old excelled on loan at Coventry in the Championship last season, playing an instrumental role in their promotion as champions, starting all 46 league matches and earning the Golden Glove award for keeping 17 clean sheets.
